description: This source file implements several utility functions for managing plugin SDK entrypoints, such as generating source paths, specifiers, package exports, and listing distribution artifacts. It also re-exports data imported from a JSON file.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkEntrySources
methods.description: Constructs an object mapping each plugin entry name to its source file path.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkSpecifiers
methods.description: Creates an array of module specifier strings for each plugin entry.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: Generates an object mapping export paths to their corresponding type definitions and JS files.

methods.name: listPluginSdkDistArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of distribution artifact file paths for all plugin entries.
